logic_group.name: zlib uncompress2 memory decompression
logic_group.description: The `uncompress2` logic group provides a simplified interface for memory-to-memory decompression using the DEFLATE algorithm. It encapsulates the complexities of managing a `z_stream` state, including proper initialization and termination. The core logic involves a state-driven inflation engine that performs Huffman decoding, handles various block types (stored, fixed, and dynamic), and manages a sliding window for distance-based decompression. This group is particularly useful for testing the robustness of the decoder against malformed or malicious compressed data streams.
